_comment: Reference totals the completeness report measures against.
THESE NUMBERS ARE UNVERIFIED. They are the commonly published figures for
Kerala's local government tiers and are recorded here so the seed report
has something to compare against — not as an authority. Replace each one
with the figure from the LSGD/LGD export you load, and set `verified` to
the date you checked. The report prints the `verified` field next to every
count so nobody mistakes an unverified baseline for an official one.

notes.wards: No reliable statewide ward total is recorded here. Ward counts are per local body and come from the delimitation notification; the loader derives the total from the file it loads.
